dedupe_keys.name: misurainternet agcom certified fixed broadband measurements ne me sys and comparative statistics by operator

description: Misurainternet is Italy's project for monitoring the quality of fixed internet access, run by AGCOM with the Istituto Superiore delle Comunicazioni e delle Tecnologie dell'Informazione, the Fondazione Ugo Bordoni, fixed network operators and consumer associations, funded by the operators and based on AGCOM decisions 244/08/CSP and 156/23/CONS. Users can run an online speed test or the Ne.Me.Sys. application, whose certified measurement has legal value and supports complaints when an operator does not meet the minimum guaranteed speed it must declare. Regional measurement probes measure the offers of each operator, and the site publishes comparative statistical values for more than 150 operators, half-yearly and annual (the 2025 annual and second-half values appeared on 1 April 2026), filterable by operator and region. A statistics page shows registered users, certificates issued by month and operator, and certificates and Ne.Me.Sys. measurements in the top 20 provinces. Coverage: Italy, fixed access. Format and access: web pages with charts and tables, free; no bulk download was found. Caveats: probe results describe tested offers, and certificate counts reflect user uptake; the legal terms for reuse were not found. Simulation uses: measured speeds by operator and region as baselines for service levels and for detecting degradation. Related records: the AGCOM Osservatorio gives lines and traffic, and Breitbandmessung, NetTest and the Ofcom performance data are comparable measurement sources.
